scope: Candidate acceptance for native integration/Art Lab, not new gameplay or complete directional systems.

decisions.notes: Revision 2 inspected at native and4x: both forearms connect the broad chest-held tablet to the torso; skeletal legs and masked green eyes read without detached equipment. Replaces rejected revision1. Single-pose future roster artwork only.
Native and4x: crisp brass pointy-hex ring with dark backing and pale cardinal marks. Transparent center leaves terrain readable. Static future overlay, not a hit target or replacement game rule.
Native and4x: pale chevron and gold destination bracket read against dark/checker backgrounds. Static north-pointing cue only; se is packaging, not a directional movement implementation.
Native and4x: four distinct approach/impact/spark/recovery poses,100ms each, fixed center. Hard alpha and controlled ember clusters; one-shot presentation only, no damage-timing authority.
Native and4x: arrow approach, centered impact, outward splinters and darkened short fade are distinct genuine100ms frames. One-shot future projectile-hit presentation only.
Native and4x: four distinct gather/release/expansion/dissipation rune poses,125ms each, fixed pivot and restrained violet ramp. Future presentation only; no casting system is implied.

Native and4x: ochre road strip with hard transparent boundaries and aligned east/west endpoints. Approved only as one straight future overlay; turns, junctions, road networks and gameplay remain unimplemented.

Native and4x: dark banks, muted blue water and broken reflections form a readable straight east/west segment. Approved only for this isolated future piece; no mouths, turns, junctions or canonical rivers.
Native and4x: small hard-edged moss fringe aligned to east hex boundary. Approved only for this one-edge source piece; not a complete adjacency-mask or biome-transition system.
